create_TavilyLoader: create a TavilyLoader instance to extract web page content from a list of URLs using the Tavily Extract API
build_TavilyLoader_advanced: build a TavilyLoader with advanced extraction depth to retrieve tables and embedded content from web pages
test_TavilyLoader_lazy_load: test the TavilyLoader lazy_load method to yield Document objects with extracted page content
refactor_TavilyLoader_continue_on_failur: refactor the TavilyLoader to handle URL extraction failures by logging errors and continuing with remaining URLs
